# Geo Point Map Picker

## Summary
Catalog map-based coordinate picker, part of the geo-point field family:
renders the point on a map and (in edit) lets the user pick by clicking.
Lives in the catalog realm at
`fields/geo-point/components/geo-point-map-picker` (default export).

## API
- `@model` — a `GeoModel` (lat/lon holder from the geo-point field)
- `@options` — `GeoPointMapOptions` (tiles, zoom)
- `@canEdit` — enables pick-on-click

## Usage
Consumed by the catalog geo-point field's edit and isolated formats. Live
examples ship with the geo-point field listing in the catalog.
